name: The Wolf Wears Red
source:
A serial killer, nicknamed "The Wolf" by townsfolk, has been ravaging the woods, claiming multiple young male victims over the past few months. The killer now sets out for her next victim.

However, her latest targets aren't so easily devoured.

[From [url=https://fluuen.itch.io/the-wolf-wears-red]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一名被镇民昵称为“狼”的连环杀手一直在森林里肆虐，在过去的几个月里夺走了多名年轻男性的生命。凶手现在开始寻找下一个受害者。

然而，她的最新目标并不那么容易被吞噬。

[来自[url=https://fluuen.itch.io/the-wolf-wears-red]itch.io[/url]]
